बॉलीवुड में डर का नया मसाला आने वाला है दोस्तों! 🔥

यश राज फिल्म्स अब पहली बार एक थियेट्रिकल हॉरर फिल्म बनाने जा रहा है, जिसमें वरुण धवन मुख्य भूमिका में नजर आएंगे। इस फिल्म को Rocket Boys फेम अभय पन्नू डायरेक्ट और राइट कर रहे हैं, जो थियेट्रिकल फीचर फिल्म के तौर पर उनका डायरेक्टोरियल डेब्यू होगा। आदित्य चोपड़ा की गाइडेंस में बन रही इस फिल्म को YRF के CEO अक्षय विधानी प्रोड्यूस करेंगे।

यह वरुण धवन की यश राज फिल्म्स के साथ दूसरी फिल्म होगी, जिसमें वह एक बिल्कुल अलग जॉनर में दिखेंगे। हालांकि मेकर्स ने फिल्म का नाम और कहानी अभी सामने नहीं रखी है, लेकिन इसकी ग्लोबल रिलीज डेट का ऐलान कर दिया है। यह थियेट्रिकल हॉरर फिल्म 31 March 2028 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 👻🎬

क्या आप वरुण धवन को YRF की पहली हॉरर फिल्म में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.text:
Directed and written by Abhay Pannu, the film will be produced by YRF CEO Akshaye Widhani under Aditya Chopra’s guidance
Yash Raj Films (YRF) is set to venture into a new genre with its first-ever horror film, featuring Varun Dhawan in the lead role. The production house has announced March 31, 2028, as the worldwide theatrical release date for the untitled project, which will be directed by Rocket Boys fame Abhay Pannu.
Known for backing films across genres such as romance, action, drama, comedy and thrillers, YRF is now expanding its cinematic portfolio with a theatrical horror feature. The upcoming film aims to bring the production house’s signature scale, filmmaking approach and cinematic vision to a horror experience designed specifically for the big screen.
The project is being developed under the guidance of Aditya Chopra, while YRF CEO Akshaye Widhani will serve as its producer. With this film, the banner is entering theatrical horror for the first time, marking a new addition to its diverse filmography.
Abhay Pannu, who gained recognition for his work on the series Rocket Boys , will not only direct the film but has also written its screenplay. The project marks his debut as a director in the theatrical feature film space. Through this collaboration, YRF continues its approach of working with emerging and unconventional storytellers while exploring different narratives within mainstream Indian cinema.
For Varun Dhawan, the film marks his second collaboration with Yash Raj Films and will see him take on a genre that is different from several of his previous projects. The actor will headline the horror feature, placing him in a new cinematic space as he explores the genre under Pannu's direction.
While the makers have not yet revealed the film's title or additional details about its storyline and cast, the announcement of its release date gives audiences a glimpse of YRF's upcoming plans. The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on March 31, 2028.
With Varun Dhawan leading the project and Abhay Pannu making his theatrical directorial debut, YRF's first horror outing is among the banner's upcoming ventures to watch out for.
